title: CrossRepoContracts
description: Registry of every cross-repo wire-format shared between sunj-labs/bassclef-upstream and sunj-labs/bassclef-cli (and future sibling repos). One entry per contract. Fields capture the five ingredients per ADR-059 § Exemplar: filename agreement + shared schema file + change ledger + CI drift check + both sides validate. The `extraction_stage` field tracks per-contract progress (declared / validated / smoked / legacy-removable) per Nygard N4. Non-JSON contracts use `sidecar_validator` per Klein K1. Partners pin against `registry_version`. Semver bump policy: (a) adding an entry to contracts[] → minor bump; (b) removing an entry → major bump; (c) adding an optional field to entry shape → minor; (d) adding a required field → major; (e) removing a field → major; (f) extraction_stage flip or content_hash change → patch bump.

_tier.description: Bassclef tier tag per ADR-043 D1. Underscore-prefix form keeps the field schema-safe while satisfying the tier-tag-required-at-write.sh hook per bassclef-upstream#1268.

registry_version.description: Semver of the registry shape. Partners pin against this value.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the registry was last written. Format pinned to YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

contracts.description: Every cross-repo wire-format. Ordered by name for deterministic diff.

name.description: Unique contract name (slug). E.g., install-written-paths, lite-manifest, bassclef-version.

format.description: Wire-format on disk. Picks the validator path. json / jsonc → ajv against schema_ref. yaml / bash → sidecar_validator per Klein K1.

writer.description: The one entity that creates or updates the wire-format on disk. Multiple writers forbidden by design (per Hoare pre/post single-writer discipline). Future multi-writer support ships as a minor bump if template-sync requires it.

readers.description: Every entity that reads the wire-format. The writer MAY also appear here (declare read-write explicitly). Minimum one reader (otherwise the contract has no cross-repo surface).

schema_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the authoritative schema file. For json/jsonc contracts this must be a JSON Schema file validated by ajv. For yaml/bash contracts this may be null when sidecar_validator carries the validation logic.

sidecar_validator.description: Repo-relative path to a bash validator for non-JSON contracts (yaml, bash). Required when format is yaml or bash. Omit for json / jsonc.

test_refs.description: Repo-relative paths to Tier 0 characterization tests pinning the contract shape. Minimum one entry.

ledger_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the per-contract change ledger (if any). May point to the master cross-repo-contracts-changes.md ledger for contracts without a dedicated file.

extraction_stage.description: Per-contract progress. declared = registry entry only; validated = both sides run ajv against schema_ref; smoked = cold-adopter harness carries a characterization test; legacy-removable = compat shim retires per ADR-031 three-release-cycle rule.

description.description: One-sentence human-readable description of what this contract carries.

hoare_pre_post.description: Optional pre/post conditions (per Hoare) the writer promises and readers depend on. Documentation shape — the validator does not enforce these directly; the test_refs do.

added_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the entry first landed.

added_in_adr.description: ADR id that introduced this contract (e.g., ADR-055 for install-written-paths).

path.description: Repo-relative path to the source file that reads or writes the contract.

access.description: read / write / read-write. Only one entry per contract may be the writer (top-level field); readers[] carry read or read-write.

consumer_type.description: How this consumer validates the contract. ajv-runtime = validates at read time via ajv. hand-coded = hardcoded shape check (the gap ingredient #5 names). codegen = TypeScript types generated from schema. shell = bash reader with no runtime validation.
